title: Create a recoverable operational backup
goal: Retain an identifiable usable copy of selected operational work and required evidence.
context: Engineering work continues while the maintainer prepares recovery material.
trigger: The maintainer requests a backup of an explicitly selected project scope.
preconditions: The actor explicitly identifies the project and intended scope.
Any requested mutation is subject to applicable project authority.

interaction.action: Selects the project, retained scope and backup destination.
Reports the captured state, included records and evidence, exclusions and whether capture completed.
Inspects the backup identity and scope before relying on it for recovery.

expected_outcome: A coherent complete backup can be identified and distinguished from incomplete attempts.

alternatives.condition: The maintainer deliberately selects less than all history.
alternatives.outcome: The retained scope and exclusions are explicit; completeness applies only to that scope.

failures.condition: Required evidence is missing or capture is interrupted.
failures.outcome: The system reports incomplete or failed capture, preserving source work and existing usable backups.
The system captures a coherent identifiable state or reports failure rather than claiming a mixed capture is complete.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
